diagnosis: (The coach's own diagnosis text was lost: its run was interrupted while the v2 eval was running, before these notes are written. The evidence it read and the changes it made are recorded below; the changes are taken from the prompt diff v1 -> v2.)
Local evidence from the v1 agent eval (train split): 4 wrong facts, 2 rejected claims, 7 unanswered questions.
Core facts that sit in the Crustdata record (founders, CEO, funding) were sometimes recorded late or not at all, and some numbers came from search snippets or secondary blogs.
Questions were sometimes marked answered without an accepted claim, and extra questions were added when the budget was nearly spent, which left open questions.
The verifier and writer sometimes returned JSON that failed validation (verdict labels, fact-sheet types), costing repair calls.

changes.why: Record every core fact from company_profile immediately, tagged with its exact field and listing all co-founders; never rely on search snippets or secondary aggregators for key numbers or team details, read the primary page instead; a question can only be marked answered with an accepted claim; add new questions only when budget remains.
changes.evidence: 4 wrong facts and 7 unanswered questions in the v1 eval; neatlogs triage items and the 'unsupported quote not found in cited source' trace search.

changes.why: The verdict must be exactly one of supported / partial / unsupported, always with a short reason.
